alice: deploybot blocked ECR publish for service `session-proxy` in staging. Provenance check failed: KMS annotation TTL mismatch (attestation timestamp 2025-07-25T10:02Z, expected recent). deploybot set publish_state=blocked. change window ends in ~45m. advice? pin previous digest or wait for re-attestation?

 deploybot: [automated] publish blocked for sha256:abcd1234... reason: provenance.kms_ttl_outdated. suggested actions: 1) manual pin to previous digest 2) re-run signing job (may take ~1h) 3) manual rollback if needed.

 ben: can we pin and promote the previous digest for the release window? what's the real risk to users?

 carmen: pinning is reasonable for staging->prod canary; previous digest (sha256:1234deadbeef) has valid attestations. risk: hidden metadata drift (unlikely). we'll add a security note in release notes and schedule re-attest.

 kevin: if we pin, I'll run the promote command and smoke tests. command I'll run:
 `deploybot promote --service=session-proxy --from-digest=sha256:1234deadbeef --to-tag=canary-20250725 --reason="provenance-block-pin"`

 maria: re-attest job on CI currently queued, ETA ~70m. if we need to wait, we miss change window. i'm on-call and can monitor metrics.

 alice: i'm leaning pin+note. Carmen can you take notes and kick the promote? we need release notes line and a Jira for follow-up.

 carmen: will do. updating release notes now. creating jira: INFRA-4281 (re-attest session-proxy publish). also adding: "temporary pin due to KMS TTL mismatch; re-attestation pending".

 kevin: started promote now. will post progress.

 deploybot: [automated] manual promote started by kevin. promoted tag canary-20250725 -> sha256:1234deadbeef. publish_state=promoted (manual). autopanic disabled for manual promotion.

 kevin: smoke tests OK (10/10), latency/err rate within baseline.

 maria: monitoring dashboards for 30m. no anomalies so far. :thumbsup: 

 ben: good call. please add a short note to release notes under 'Risk and mitigation' for the next release announcement.

 carmen: release notes updated and INFRA-4281 created. marking this thread resolved when postmortem scheduled.

 alice: thanks everyone. we'll re-run signing job and update INFRA-4281 with results. closing the change window with manual pin.

 deploybot: [automated] thread closed by alice. timestamps: root=1748205432, last_action=1748206499.
